parsed.reason: Most of this is good. The picks are real, local, named and fit the stage: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's Parent and Tot and Pre-school Drop In, and the Town's Parent & Tot Skating. It leads with the best find by name and attributes it with 'their site says'. Every time and price matches the picks, and there is no link and no question. Because watch is true, the first-person 'I'll keep watching and text you' is a real commitment and is correct. The failure is the skating line, 'no day posted yet'. That is a negative claim about what a page carries, and pageEvidence is no_page_read, so nobody opened a page today. The claim is unearned; it should have been 'I could not get into their page today'. The skating facts also lack their own attribution to the Town. An unearned negative claim scores low.
